programme.title: An Art Lovers' Guide
programme.desc: Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke embark on more cultural city breaks, beginning by heading to the Portuguese capital to see what it has to offer. From a spectacular monument to the maritime globetrotting of Portugal's golden age and the work of a photographer documenting the city's large African population, they discover a complex history of former glories and a darker, slave-trading past

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art
programme.desc: Lachlan Goudie looks at art in the years between 1880 and the outbreak of the First World War, examining how a new generation of artists captured the spirit of Scotland at the dawn of a modern age. He explores how the Glasgow Boys set out to reflect the lives of ordinary people, in a move away from romanticised highland views, and he discovers how Arthur Melville pushed the boundaries of watercolour painting. He also looks at William McTaggart's landscapes, Charles Rennie Mackintosh's re-working of old-age forms, and JD Fergusson's series of canvases that were simultaneously modern, Continental and Scottish

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Visits to historic places of work, including one of Britain's oldest dockyards in Chatham Kent, and Armley Mill in Leeds. At a 1,000-year-old tithe barn in Sussex, the steeplejack tries his hand at thatching, before getting a surprise on the top floor of the architecturally esteemed Lloyd's building in the City of London

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: Richard Holmes traces the events of the Battle of the Somme on July 1, 1916, the blackest episode in British military history, when 57,000 Allied soldiers were killed or wounded in a matter of hours

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Marjory and DeVere are thrilled to discover a rare tropical bird nesting on the estate, but Audrey soon finds the feathered fiend is interfering with her honey business. Comedy, starring Penelope Keith, Peter Bowles and Angela Thorne. First shown in 1981

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Although Emmet's musical is already fully cast, Hyacinth remains convinced that his shyness is the only reason she has not been given a starring role. Suburban sitcom, starring Patricia Routledge, David Griffin and Geoffrey Hughes

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: After Charles I's disastrous attempt to impose political and religious uniformity throughout England, Scotland and Ireland, both the Stuart dynasty and its three kingdoms fell into an abyss. In this episode, Dr Clare Jackson reveals how the unprecedented religious violence of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms shaped British political culture and subsequent constitutional crises

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: The story of CIA officer Peter Sichel - a Jewish refugee who fled Nazi Germany before becoming one of the most influential figures in American intelligence. Sichel rose to serve as the CIA's first Station Chief in post-war Berlin and played a pivotal role in some of the defining geopolitical events of the Cold War. Featuring interviews with the man himself before his death in 2024

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: Helen Czerski examines the complexities of colour, including what it is, how it works, and how it has written the story of the planet. In the first edition, she looks for the colours that have made the earth multi-coloured, investigating the essence of sunlight, how vivid blue is formed from sulphur atoms, and why the presence of red ochre is a key sign of life. She also looks at why gold should not even exist on the surface of the planet, and the role of salt and water in shaping planet earth

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: The former steeplejack explores the achievements of Britain's civil engineering pioneers, visiting the Channel Tunnel, Humber Bridge and Pontcysyllte Aqueduct. He also has a go at legging a narrowboat through a canal tunnel in Dudley in the West Midlands

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: Military historian Richard Holmes recounts the German invasion of France in 1940, when Allied forces attempted to halt the Panzer divisions' relentless advance. Nazi commanders bypassed the fortified Maginot line by invading via Belgium, sweeping aside a makeshift opposition comprising over-age reservists, a French North African cavalry unit and outmoded British tanks. The Allies eventually launched a counter-attack near Arras - but by then it was too late

programme.title: Chauvet: Humanity's First Great Masterpiece
programme.desc: Following a 30-year archaeological, geological and artistic adventure as scientists endeavour to understand and conserve the art of the Chauvet cave. Hidden deep inside France's Gorges de l'Ardèche, the cave was revealed to the modern world for the very first time in 1994. It has over 1,000 paintings adorning its walls and scientists immediately recognised the importance of the discovery

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox examines the remotest part of the solar system, a place that the most mysterious planets - Uranus, Neptune and dwarf planet Pluto - call home. Barely visible to the naked eye, Uranus was once thought to be the furthest planet from the Sun, before Neptune was discovered. Thanks to a rare alignment of the planets in 1976, Voyager 2 was sent for mankind's only flyby of these ice worlds. Even at such cold temperatures, great storms whip around these frozen worlds, which are home to spectacular moons and intricate ring systems. Then in 2015, Nasa's New Horizons probe pushed the frontier even further into space with its extraordinary passage to the dwarf planet Pluto

programme.title: Zoe Wanamaker Remembers - David Copperfield
programme.desc: Actress Zoe Wanamaker takes a look back at the BBC's star-studded adaptation of the Dickens classic from 1999, in which she played Miss Murdstone, alongside a young Daniel Radcliffe in his first acting role

programme.title: David Copperfield
programme.desc: The rural idyll of eight-year-old David Copperfield is brought to an abrupt end when his widowed mother Clara remarries. Young David takes an instant dislike to Mr Murdstone, his new stepfather, and the newcomer proves the feeling is more than mutual when he send the lad away to a boarding school run by a ruthless headmaster. Adaptation of the Dickens classic, starring a pre-Harry Potter Daniel Radcliffe, with Pauline Quirke, Maggie Smith. Trevor Eve and Ian McKellen

programme.title: David Copperfield
programme.desc: Now an ambitious young man making a name for himself in London, David returns to Suffolk with his schoolfriend Steerpike in tow to catch up with Peggotty, his late mother's maid. Adaptation of the Dickens classic, starring Pauline Quirke and Ciarán McMenamin

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: The hunt for a missing person in the vast rural area around Golspie sees search dog handler PC Adam Naismith and German shepherd Wolf deployed, but the case takes a turn when police discover he is wanted for questioning by another force. Inverness CID carry out a major operation against county lines drug dealers. On Skye, Sgt Gordon McKay comes to the aid of a stranded tourist with a nasty hillwalking injury

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul
programme.desc: The chef's gastronomic road trip brings him to northern Greece where he enjoys traditional dishes including veal stiffado and kotopita - which Rick declares to be the best chicken pie he has ever tasted. In the coastal city of Preveza he goes out prawn fishing and follows in the footsteps of poet Lord Byron visiting Messolonghi, a city where seafood is a highly regarded commodity. Rick also rolls up his own sleeves to cook his favourite Greek dishes of stuffed peppers and tomatoes and souvlaki

programme.title: Rick Stein: From Venice to Istanbul
programme.desc: The chef continues his 900-mile road trip from Venice to Istanbul, sampling that array of gastronomic delights that lie on the route. In the penultimate episode Rick arrives in the Greek Peloponnese where he samples mouth-watering dishes such as rooster stew hilopites with mizithra cheese, and a home-made moussaka he claims is the best he have ever savoured. In his Symi island kitchen, Rick rolls up his sleeves to prepare galaktoboureko, a dessert of semolina custard in filo pastry, a favourite dish in Greece

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers explore Britain's fondness for picnics, preparing an alfresco lunch at Beaufort Polo Club in the Cotswolds. They also discover how the habit of outdoor dining in summer evolved into its current form, celebrate snacks such as Cornish pasties and Scotch eggs, and bake a Dundee cake

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales continue their Swedish canal odyssey, following the ancient routes of the Vikings and travelling to Stockholm, where they navigate the city's canals. They later head out into the far-flung islands of the archipelago, before paying a visit to Drottningholm Palace Theatre, where they meet Wallander actor Krister Henriksson

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson and the gang are back with another high-octane instalment of the popular motoring series. The Porsche 911 is put through its paces on the racetrack and the British Jaguar S type is pitted against its rivals, the American Chrysler 300C and the Australian Vauxhall Monaro VXR. Plus, a chance to help preserve an element of motoring history in Restoration. Comedian Bill Bailey is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car

programme.title: Guy Martin: Arctic Warrior
programme.desc: Part two of two. Guy's Arctic adventure continues focusing his training on combat. He starts with an amphibious raid, storming a beach with 30 other commandos and rides a £1million all-terrain attack vehicle. He's also attached to an experienced strike group training to operate behind enemy lines. Armed with a rifle, three magazines of bullets, and his snowshoes, Guy must fight in deep snow and temperatures averaging minus 20C, overcome an enemy sniper, save a casualty and arrange an emergency helicopter evacuation

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities

programme.title: Prime Suspect
programme.desc: Part one of two. DCI Jane Tennison is transferred to the vice squad, where she is reluctantly re-teamed with old adversary Bill Otley and put in charge of an operation to rid the area of rent boys and prostitutes. However, the discovery of a teenager's burned body in a transsexual's flat soon leads her into another major murder investigation. Helen Mirren stars, with Tom Bell, David Thewlis and Peter Capaldi

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: An eccentric elderly lady reports an abduction, presenting the Aidensfield coppers with a fresh mystery to solve, while Greengrass has dealings with an old crony who wants him to enter a champion ferret in a race. Rural drama, starring Bill Maynard, Derek Fowlds and Margery Mason

programme.title: Inspector Morse
programme.desc: A rehearsal of an amateur operatic production ends with Morse being arrested on suspicion of murder and suspended from duty pending further investigation. Stripped of official powers, he fights to clear his name - unaware he has been pencilled in as the real killer's next target. Guest starring Ian McDiarmid, with John Thaw and Kevin Whately

programme.title: Call the Cleaners
programme.desc: Cameras follow mother and daughter Maxine and Jasmine as they face one of their biggest hoarder jobs yet - an elderly man who has a bungalow packed with 30 years' worth of belongings. Meanwhile, George and his team face a difficult clean up after a body was discovered in a flat

programme.title: Alex Polizzi: My Hotel Nightmare
programme.desc: Alex has spent the last three months in lockdown in Cornwall with her family, overseeing the work at The Star from a distance. All work at the hotel had stopped temporarily, but it's back up and running. When Alex is able to travel to Sussex to see the renovations, it becomes clear just how far behind they are. Because of delays and the possibility of now having a Christmas opening, Alex and Olga move the opening until Easter 2021

programme.title: My Unique B&B
programme.desc: Simon Parfett and his team help create a unique agricultural-themed B&B for Will and his family, who have been farming their land in Lincolnshire for generations

programme.title: My Unique B&B
programme.desc: Simon Parfett and his team help Nigel and Maria, who inherited a 400-year-old farm near Cullompton in Devon. They now want to convert a 1970s showman's caravan into a hostelry

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: An investigation into a cattle auctioneer puts Mike's career in danger when he finds himself under suspicion of taking bribes. The case also puts his relationship with his wife in jeopardy, culminating in a final, shocking revelation from Jackie. Meanwhile, Vernon attempts to bottle the secret of eternal youth

programme.title: Upstairs, Downstairs
programme.desc: The Bellamys learn of Sarah's pregnancy, and to protect the real father she tells them she was seduced by a stranger. Watkins the chauffeur offers to marry her and deviously turns the situation to his advantage, but his plot is under threat of being uncovered

programme.title: Help Me Buy a Home
programme.desc: Buyers agent Liz O'Kane records the unfiltered realities Irish people face in the search for a home, taking a raw and honest look at the emotional rollercoaster, challenges and hard-won joys of buying a property

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Samson's legal situation worsens, while Graham keeps a watchful eye and a stolen moment between Caleb and Sadie leaves them terrified of discovery

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Ryan objects to being drawn into Bethany's web of lies, Lisa delivers a worrying update on Jodie, Amy leaves Tracy in the lurch, and Bernie reaches a life-changing decision

programme.title: The Royal
programme.desc: Dr Ormerod returns to work after his accident, but when his brusque treatment of a hypochondriac schoolgirl ends in tragedy, it's clear he still needs time to recover. New nurse Catherine Deane starts her rounds on the wards, and Mr Middleditch has a surprise announcement to make. Robert Daws, Amelia Curtis and Ian Carmichael star

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple
programme.sub-title: The Mirror Crack'd from Side to Side
programme.desc: Hollywood actress Marina Gregg and her director husband take up residence at Gossington Hall in the village of St Mary Mead and hold a reception to meet their new neighbours, including the hall's previous owner Dolly Bantry. The celebrations turn to tragedy, however, after a fan fatally drinks a poisoned cocktail apparently meant for the new lady of the manor. But a different picture begins to emerge as Marina spits out a similarly spiked cup of coffee on the set of her new film - and Miss Marple investigates the star's unhappy past. Julia McKenzie stars, with Lindsay Duncan, Nigel Harman, Joanna Lumley, Martin Jarvis, Hugh Bonneville and Michele Dotrice

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: Part one of two. Mike faces a stressful time as he struggles to cope with his wife's departure, and Tricia offers him a shoulder to cry on, but is beset by problems of her own after prescribing birth control to a 16-year-old. Meanwhile, Sergeant Craddock finds his efforts to prepare for an important visit hampered by a series of attacks on the station, and Vernon makes a startling discovery in his bathtub. Jason Durr and Clare Calbraith star

programme.title: Live UEFA Nations League
programme.desc: Hungary v Northern Ireland (Kick-off 7.45pm). Coverage of the UEFA Nations League Group B2 match from Puskás Aréna in Budapest. These teams faced each other on matchday two at Windsor Park in September when they played out a goalless draw in a match of few chances, which nevertheless ensured Michael O'Neill's men started the campaign by earning four points from the first six available

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: The detective investigates a suspicious death in an army barracks, aided by Joe and an enthusiastic member of the military police. Although the demise of commanding officer Dev initially looks like suicide, a case for murder is quickly established and the team's first task is to find a motive. Sensing a connection to Ollie, a soldier killed in Afghanistan, Vera interviews the victim's loyal comrades and Ollie's grieving family, discovering a traumatic event that nobody wants to talk about. John Duttine (Heartbeat) guest stars alongside Brenda Blethyn, David Leon, Jon Morrison and Paul Ritter
